Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms.

The costs of visiting the site shall be borne by the Bidder. should be borne by the bidder 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) Procurement of Dining Table Accessories and Decorative Items 1. Quality of Material: All items shall be brand new, unused, defect-free and of superior commercial qua lity. The material used shall be durable, colourfast, skin-friendly, washable and suitable for regular use in d ining facilities. Recycled, substandard, damaged or inferior-quality material shall not be accepted. 2. Compliance with Technical Specifications: The bidder shall strictly supply all items in accordance with the item descriptions, dimensions, quantities and specifications mentioned in the GeM bid. No deviati on in size, material, colour, design or finish shall be permitted without prior written approval of the Buyer. 3. Dimensions and Measurements: All dimensions specified in the bid shall be adhered to. The Buyer r eserves the right to verify the dimensions of each item at the time of delivery. Items having incorrect dime nsions or specifications shall be liable for rejection. 4. Fabric Quality and Finish: All fabric-based items, including dining table mats, table runners, table na pkins, table cloths, chair covers and tray cloths, shall have uniform weaving, neat stitching, properly finish ed edges and consistent colour and texture. The fabric shall not shrink excessively, bleed colour or lose its appearance during normal washing and usage.

5. Design and Appearance: The white table cloth with flower print shall have a neat, uniform and aesthe tically suitable floral design. All supplied items shall have a professional appearance, proper finishing and be suitable for use in an official dining facility. 6. Brass Menu Card Stand: The menu card stand shall be made of good-quality brass with a smooth, po lished and corrosion-resistant finish. The required logo shall be properly engraved or permanently affixed, with clear visibility and neat finishing. The logo/design shall be approved by the Buyer before final supply, wherever applicable. 7. Flower Pots: Flower pots shall be of good-quality material, properly finished, stable in placement and f ree from cracks, sharp edges, deformation or manufacturing defects. The dimensions shall conform to the specifications mentioned in the bid. 8. Sample Approval: The Buyer reserves the right to demand samples of any or all items from the succe ssful bidder before bulk supply. The approved sample shall be treated as the benchmark for quality, materi al, colour, design, dimensions and finishing. Bulk supply not conforming to the approved sample shall be re jected. 9. Delivery Period: The complete supply of all items shall be made within 15 days from the date of issua nce of the GeM contract/order, at the consignee's designated location. No additional delivery charges shall be admissible. 10. Inspection and Acceptance: All items shall be subject to physical inspection by the consignee or an authorised inspection committee. The inspection shall include verification of quantity, dimensions, materia l quality, workmanship, finishing and conformity with the bid specifications. Acceptance shall be subject to satisfactory inspection. 11. Replacement of Defective Items: Any item found damaged, defective, substandard, incorrectly sized or not conforming to the stipulated specifications shall be rejected. The successful bidder shall repla ce such items with fresh and compliant items within 07 days of notification, entirely at its own cost, withou t any additional financial liability to the Buyer. 12. Packaging and Transportation: All items shall be properly packed to prevent damage, deformation , stains, moisture exposure or deterioration during transportation and handling. The responsibility for safe delivery up to the consignee's location shall rest entirely with the successful bidder. 13. No Substitution: The successful bidder shall not supply alternative products, different designs, mate rials or dimensions without obtaining prior written approval from the Buyer. 14. Payment Terms: Payment shall be processed through GeM strictly as per applicable Government of I ndia and GeM provisions, subject to successful delivery, satisfactory inspection and acceptance of the sup plied items, along with submission of requisite documents. 15. Cancellation and Risk Purchase: In case of failure to supply the items within the stipulated delivery period, supply of non-conforming items, or failure to replace rejected items, the Buyer shall be entitled to t ake appropriate action, including cancellation of the contract and other remedies available under applicabl e GeM terms and Government rules. 16. Final Authority: The decision of the Buyer/Consignee regarding conformity of the supplied items with the specifications and approved samples shall be final for the purpose of inspection and acceptance, subje ct to applicable contractual provisions and rules . 12.
